Public Comment Guidelines

Public comment may be made in person, via phone, or via email.

In Person

Public comment may be provided in person at the ACCS meeting. Individuals who wish to provide either general public comment or public comment on a specific agenda item must sign up on the applicable public comment sign-in sheet prior to the comment period. Individuals will form a queue when prompted by the ACCS Chair and will provide public comment when the moderator calls their name.

Public comment is limited to one minute per individual.

Phone

Public comment may be provided by dialing the phone number, entering the participant access code, and following the operator’s prompts. The number and access code will be provided at the start of general public comment and at the start of public comment for each item.

Members of the public wishing to dial in for public comment should view the live webcast of the meeting and make sure that the volume of the live webcast is muted to avoid echoing or other feedback sounds during the call. Upon dialing in, callers will be added to a caller queue. The operator will notify callers when it is their turn to provide public comment. Once unmuted by the operator, the caller will hear a voice announcement informing them that they are unmuted. The operator will inform the caller that their time to provide public comment has started.

Public comment will be limited to one minute per individual. The operator will announce to the caller when their time is up.

To provide public comment by phone, use the phone number and access code provided below:

  • Phone number: 717-908-1926
  • Access code: 1166083#

Email

Written comment may be submitted via email in advance of the meeting for consideration. To help ensure that commissioners have time to review written comment, comments should be submitted by 5 p.m. on Thursday, October 1, 2026. Comments received after that time will be forwarded to commissioners until 5 p.m. on Monday, October 5; however, only comments received by the October 1 deadline will be posted to the ACCS agenda prior to the meeting.

Comments should be submitted to the ACCS via email at charters@cde.ca.gov and include the following:

  • Commenter’s first and last name
  • Organization affiliation
  • General public comment or agenda item number

Order of Business

Notice is hereby given that the order of consideration of matters on this agenda may be changed without prior notice.

Reasonable Limitations

The presiding officer of the ACCS reserves the right to impose reasonable time limits on public testimony to ensure that the agenda is completed.

Special Presentations

Consistent with the requirements of the Bagley-Keene Open Meeting Act, notice is hereby given that special presentations not mentioned on the agenda may be made at this meeting; however, any such presentation will be for information only.
